title: Production queue behavior

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 558530 (0x000885c2), HLP file offset 144311 (0x000233b7), topic 59 'How Production Works'
provenance.note: Top-down queue, partial items, mineral block.

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 560433 (0x00088d31), HLP file offset 146214 (0x00023b26), topic 60 'Adding an Item to the Production Queue'

setup.baseline: An owned planet with a controlled queue and mineral supply.

procedure: Record the queue and percentage complete.
Insert an item at the top and record whether partial work continues.
Remove all minerals and record where production stops.

documented: Production is processed top-down; inserting at the top prevents work on the previous item until the new item completes or is deleted (documented-only).
Production halts when the planet runs out of minerals (documented-only).
Unique items disappear from inventory once queued; upgrades replace older versions and require only enhancement minerals (documented-only).

unresolved: Exact resource/mineral allocation order within one queue item is unknown.
Rounding and partial-progress behavior are unverified.
